title: Golisano Children's Museum of Naples

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: to Golisano Children’s Museum of Naples (CMON) offer students a playful, hands-on learning experience rooted in STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Art, and Math) education. Our 2.5-hour self-guided visits are ideal for schools, homeschool groups, and youth programs seeking a fun and educational day outside the classroom. Located in Naples, Florida, CMON is a top-rated field trip destination for children ages 2-12, blending exploration and education in an environment designed just for kids.
